column1: # Pinned materialisation counts for constants whose site count appears in a published claim.
# Every row is re-derived on each run by two independent readers (instruction decode vs raw byte search);
# both must agree with each other AND with the pinned number, or tools/audit/literal-counts-check.mjs exits 1.
# Re-pinning a row is a deliberate act: recompute, correct every document that quotes the old number,
# then change this column. Never edit a row to make the gate green.
# Why the gate exists: on 2026-11-09 the session published "298 sites" for 0x1404 and "exactly 3 writers"
# for 0x73e0. The MCP literal_loads tool under-reports even over the whole text (0x1404: 298 vs 301,
# 0xba44: 126 vs 127), and the writer census missed the strh lane and pre-index writeback. Neither was
# caught because no step compared two readers before the number reached a document.
